# Fill only the requested cells Q7:Q153.
# Logic:
# 1st withdrawal: 20000 when M+O exceeds threshold in P6.
# 2nd withdrawal: 20000 within 7 days of the previous withdrawal and balance again exceeds P6.
# 3rd withdrawal: at least 7 days after the 2nd; withdraw everything above 10000.
# 4th withdrawal: 20000 when balance again exceeds P6.
for r in range(7, 154):

    if r == 7:
        formula = f'=IF({bal}>$P$6,20000,0)'
    else:
        prev_q = f"$Q$7:Q{r-1}"
        prev_f = f"$F$7:F{r-1}"
        formula = (
            f'=IF(COUNTIF({prev_q},">0")=0,'
                f'IF({bal}>$P$6,20000,0),'
              f'IF(COUNTIF({prev_q},">0")=1,'
                f'IF(AND({bal}>$P$6,F{r}-LOOKUP(2,1/({prev_q}>0),{prev_f})<=7),20000,0),'
              f'IF(COUNTIF({prev_q},">0")=2,'
                f'IF(F{r}-LOOKUP(2,1/({prev_q}>0),{prev_f})>=7,MAX({bal}-10000,0),0),'
              f'IF(COUNTIF({prev_q},">0")=3,'
                f'IF({bal}>$P$6,20000,0),'
                f'0))))'
        )
    
    ws[f"Q{r}"] = formula

# Ensure formulas recalculate when opened.

    wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
    wb.calculation.forceFullCalc = True
    wb.calculation.calcMode = "auto"
except Exception:
    pass

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
